steps.note: Before index i, arr[i] − (i+1) positives are missing. Find where that count first reaches 5.
Up to arr[2] = 4, 1.0 numbers are missing — fewer than 5, go right.
Up to arr[3] = 7, 3.0 numbers are missing — fewer than 5, go right.
Up to arr[4] = 11, 6.0 numbers are missing — at least 5, go left.
The range closed with 4 array value(s) below the answer, so the 5th missing number is 5 + 4 = 9.
